snippet.description:
Three beluga whales recently died at Chicago’s Shedd Aquarium. It speaks to a larger issue — animals in captivity can’t get what they need to thrive. Vox’s Kenny Torrella explains how the conditions can be “torturous” for highly intelligent and social beluga whales.

Read more: https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/502874/beluga-whales-marineland-shedd-aquarium
